university.name: University of Nottingham
university.summary: The University of Nottingham is a Russell Group university based in Nottingham, England. It offers undergraduate, taught postgraduate and research degrees across arts, social sciences, science, engineering, and medicine and health sciences, and is a licensed student sponsor. This record covers the UK campus only.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor, Student route, Higher Education Institution, rating Student Sponsor - Track Record (gov.uk register dated 2026-10-07)

courses.title: Computer Science BSc (Hons)
courses.overview: A three year degree (UCAS G400) covering programming, algorithms, computer architecture, software engineering, databases, networks and artificial intelligence, with mathematics for computing taught in the first year.
courses.academic_requirements: A levels: AAA (AAB including A in computer science; A level ICT or IT do not qualify for the lower offer). IB: 34 points or 666 in 3 HL; 32 points including HL 6 in computer science. Applies to 2027 entry.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element). TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE, GCSE, IB and O level English also accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The University's Pakistan page states that applicants with Intermediate/HSSC qualifications usually need to complete a foundation course first, offered at the University of Nottingham International College (run with Kaplan). Entry requirements for the foundation are set by Kaplan and were not verified. A level and IB applicants are assessed against the course requirements.
courses.notes: International fee from the official 2027/28 undergraduate fee table; the course page shows the same amount. The page does not state whether the international fee changes in later years. PTE 71 (minimum 65) is the University's published equivalent of IELTS 6.5 (6.0) on its English equivalencies page. Applicants without the required subjects can take the Engineering and Physical Sciences foundation route (UK students) or the International College foundation (international students).

courses.title: Law LLB (Hons)
courses.overview: A three year qualifying law degree (UCAS M100) that starts with the foundations of English law, including contract, tort, public law and land law, alongside legal theory.
courses.academic_requirements: A levels: AAA (three A levels or equivalent) plus at least five GCSEs at grade 4 (C) or above including English. IB: 34 points or 666 in 3 HL. Applies to 2027 entry.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.5 in any element). TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE, GCSE, IB and O level English also accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The University's Pakistan page states that applicants with Intermediate/HSSC qualifications usually need to complete a foundation course first, offered at the University of Nottingham International College (run with Kaplan). Entry requirements for the foundation are set by Kaplan and were not verified. A level and IB applicants are assessed against the course requirements.
courses.notes: International fee from the official 2027/28 undergraduate fee table; the course page shows the same amount. The page does not state whether the international fee changes in later years. No admissions test is mentioned on the course page. PTE equivalent for IELTS 6.5 with 6.5 in each element is not listed on the equivalencies page, so min_pte is left null.

courses.title: Mechanical Engineering BEng (Hons)
courses.overview: A three year engineering degree (UCAS H302) covering mechanics, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, materials and manufacturing, electromechanical systems and computational methods, with project and professional practice work.
courses.academic_requirements: A levels: AAA, including A in maths and either physics or further maths, or any two of chemistry, biology, design, electronics. IB: 34 points or 666 in 3 HL. Applies to 2027 entry.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element). TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE, GCSE, IB and O level English also accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The University's Pakistan page states that applicants with Intermediate/HSSC qualifications usually need to complete a foundation course first, offered at the University of Nottingham International College (run with Kaplan). Entry requirements for the foundation are set by Kaplan and were not verified. A level and IB applicants are assessed against the course requirements.
courses.notes: International fee from the official 2027/28 undergraduate fee table; the course page shows the same amount. The page does not state whether the international fee changes in later years. PTE 65 (minimum 59) is the University's published equivalent of IELTS 6.0 (5.5). Module list on the page is not labelled by year; highlights are taken from the listed modules.

courses.title: Business and Management BSc (Hons)
courses.overview: A three year degree (UCAS N200) introducing accounting, economics, marketing, operations and organisational behaviour in the first year, with work on entrepreneurship, research methods and employability.
courses.academic_requirements: A levels: AAA / A*AB / A*A*C, with GCSE maths grade 6 (B) and GCSE English grade 4 (C). IB: 34 points or 666 in 3 HL. Applies to 2027 entry.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element). TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE, GCSE, IB and O level English also accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The University's Pakistan page states that applicants with Intermediate/HSSC qualifications usually need to complete a foundation course first, offered at the University of Nottingham International College (run with Kaplan). Entry requirements for the foundation are set by Kaplan and were not verified. A level and IB applicants are assessed against the course requirements.
courses.notes: International fee from the official 2027/28 undergraduate fee table; the course page shows the same amount. The page does not state whether the international fee changes in later years. PTE 71 (minimum 65) is the University's published equivalent of IELTS 6.5 (6.0).

courses.title: Management MSc
courses.overview: A one year conversion master's for graduates from non business disciplines, covering economics, accounting, marketing, people management, strategy and leadership, ending with a dissertation or business project. Students can also gain a CMI Level 7 Diploma.
courses.academic_requirements: 2:1 (or international equivalent) in any discipline, excluding business and/or management. Applies to 2027 entry.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in each element). TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE, GCSE, IB and O level English also accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: a relevant Bachelor's degree from a recognised Pakistani university equivalent to a UK 2:1. For four year Bachelor's degrees the 2:1 equivalent is 70%+ or CGPA 3.01 to 3.74, or 65%+ or CGPA 2.9 depending on the university of study. Holders of two or three year Bachelor's degrees must also have a first division pass in a Master's degree.
courses.notes: International fee from the official 2027/28 postgraduate taught fee table; the course page shows the same amount. Not open to graduates of business or management degrees. pk_min_percent and pk_min_cgpa use the standard 2:1 figures; some Pakistani universities qualify at 65% or CGPA 2.9.

courses.title: Finance and Investment MSc
courses.overview: A one year master's covering capital markets, corporate finance, fixed income and derivatives, with financial modelling and data analytics, ending with a dissertation or business project.
courses.academic_requirements: 2:1 (or international equivalent), with at least two undergraduate modules covering at least two of: mathematics, statistics, quantitative methods, quantitative finance specialisms, econometrics. Applies to 2027 entry.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in each element). TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE, GCSE, IB and O level English also accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: a relevant Bachelor's degree from a recognised Pakistani university equivalent to a UK 2:1. Holders of two or three year Bachelor's degrees must also have a first division pass in a Master's degree.
courses.notes: International fee from the official 2027/28 postgraduate taught fee table; the course page shows the same amount. The course page module lists are not fully consistent between sections; highlights use modules listed as core.

courses.title: Data Science MSc
courses.overview: A one year master's in data science with pathway and optional modules in algorithms, machine learning and statistics, completed with a 60 credit individual research project. No prior programming experience is required.
courses.academic_requirements: 2:1 (or international equivalent), with an affinity for programming and/or advanced statistics shown through prior study or practical experience. Graduates from other fields with a strong mathematics and/or computer science background are considered with a 60% average mark. Applies to 2027 entry.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (with at least 6.0 in each element). TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE, GCSE, IB and O level English also accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: a relevant Bachelor's degree from a recognised Pakistani university equivalent to a UK 2:1. For four year Bachelor's degrees the 2:1 equivalent is 70%+ or CGPA 3.01 to 3.74, or 65%+ or CGPA 2.9 depending on the university of study. Holders of two or three year Bachelor's degrees must also have a first division pass in a Master's degree.
courses.notes: International fee from the official 2027/28 postgraduate taught fee table; the course page shows the same amount. Only the Research Project is core for all students; other highlighted modules are options or pathway requirements.

courses.title: Master of Public Health MPH
courses.overview: A taught master's in public health covering population health, health protection and improvement, public health interventions and research methods, with a research project for the MPH award. PGDip and PGCert exits are also available.
highlights: Population Health Research Methods and Practice
courses.academic_requirements: Standard requirement 2:1. A 2:2 may be considered with relevant work experience in public health, global health or health research and a successful interview. Applies to 2027 entry.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in each component). TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE, GCSE, IB and O level English also accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: a relevant Bachelor's degree from a recognised Pakistani university equivalent to a UK 2:1. For four year Bachelor's degrees the 2:1 equivalent is 70%+ or CGPA 3.01 to 3.74, or 65%+ or CGPA 2.9 depending on the university of study. Holders of two or three year Bachelor's degrees must also have a first division pass in a Master's degree.
courses.notes: International fee from the official 2027/28 postgraduate taught fee table; the course page shows the same amount. Fee table on the course page shows the same international fee for MPH, PGDip and PGCert.

courses.title: Advanced Civil Engineering MSc
courses.overview: A one year master's for civil engineering graduates, combining advanced technical study with contextual topics in civil engineering, technical writing and an individual project.
courses.academic_requirements: 2:1 in a relevant subject, having studied multiple courses in Structures, Geotechnics and Fluids. Applies to 2027 entry.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in each element). TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE, GCSE, IB and O level English also accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: a relevant Bachelor's degree from a recognised Pakistani university equivalent to a UK 2:1. For four year Bachelor's degrees the 2:1 equivalent is 70%+ or CGPA 3.01 to 3.74, or 65%+ or CGPA 2.9 depending on the university of study. Holders of two or three year Bachelor's degrees must also have a first division pass in a Master's degree.
courses.notes: International fee from the official 2027/28 postgraduate taught fee table; the course page shows the same amount. This course was on the 2026 entry Commonwealth Shared Scholarship list (2027 list not yet published).

scholarships.name: International Postgraduate Masters Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,000 deducted from the master's tuition fee (first year only for two year master's)
scholarships.summary: An automatic GBP 3,000 tuition fee reduction for self-funded international students starting a full-time taught master's at the UK campus in 2027. No separate application is needed.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee-paying, self-funded students starting year one of a full-time UK campus taught master's (MA, MSc, MArch, MBA, LLM, MPA, MPH or MMedSci); not holding any other University award or external sponsorship.
scholarships.deadline_note: No scholarship application or deadline; awarded automatically.
scholarships.notes: Students progressing from Kaplan (University of Nottingham International College or Digital Pathways) are not eligible. Sponsored students are not eligible. Terms state the University reserves the right of awarding scholarships and some exceptions may apply.

scholarships.name: International Undergraduate Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 deducted from first year tuition fees
scholarships.summary: An automatic GBP 5,000 reduction on first year tuition for self-funded international students admitted to a full-time UK campus bachelor's degree with AAA at A level or an international equivalent.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee-paying, self-funded students starting year one of a full-time UK campus undergraduate degree (BA, BSc/MSci, BEng/MEng, LLB, BArch, MMath or MNutr) with AAA or international equivalent; excludes Veterinary Medicine and Surgery, Pharmacy, Medicine and Foundation Year programmes.
scholarships.deadline_note: No scholarship application or deadline; assessed at the point of successful admission.
scholarships.notes: The award page does not state an entry year; terms appear current but 2027 entry is not explicitly confirmed. Students progressing from Kaplan (University of Nottingham International College or Digital Pathways) are not eligible, so Pakistani applicants entering via the foundation route would not qualify; those with A levels or IB at the required level could.

scholarships.name: International Sporting Excellence Award
scholarships.value_text: GBP 1,000 to GBP 7,000 towards full-time tuition fees
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee award for international students of academy, national or international standard in any sport, or with strong evidence of future potential, who hold an offer for a full-time course at the UK campus.
scholarships.criteria_text: International students of academy, national or international standard in any sport, or showing strong evidence of future outstanding potential, holding an offer to start a full-time course in any subject at the University of Nottingham UK.
scholarships.deadline_note: Opens in January each year; expression of interest form first, then a sport scholarship application. No closing date stated.
scholarships.notes: Page states the award applies at any study level and opens in January each year; no specific entry year or deadline is stated. value_amount left null because the published value is a range.

Finance and Investment MSc page lists Derivative Investment as core in one section and optional in another.

excluded_and_why: International foundation route (University of Nottingham International College, Kaplan): published fees are 2026/27 'from' figures (Science and Engineering from GBP 25,380; Business, Law and Social Sciences from GBP 23,110) and entry requirements for Pakistan could not be verified.
Engineering and Physical Sciences Foundation (H100): Home students only.
Developing Solutions Masters Scholarship: Pakistan eligible, 50% or 100% of tuition, but published terms are for September 2026 entry and the deadline has passed; 2027 terms not published.
Commonwealth Shared Scholarship: Pakistan listed, but terms are for September 2026 entry only; jointly run with the CSC.
Commonwealth PhD Scholarship, Commonwealth Master's, Chevening, HEC and Charles Wallace awards: run by external bodies, not the University.
South Asia Undergraduate and Postgraduate Excellence Awards: replaced by the International Undergraduate Excellence Scholarship and International Postgraduate Masters Scholarship.
Hong Kong Alumni, China and Malaysia Alumni, GREAT (China, Indonesia, Kenya), China Scholarship Council and Deng Yaping awards: not open to Pakistani or UK resident applicants or country restricted.
Sports Scholarships (separate performance sport scheme): terms not reviewed.
client_should_confirm: International undergraduate fees are confirmed for 2027/28 only; course pages do not say whether international fees change in later years.
pk_min_percent 70 and pk_min_cgpa 3.01 are the standard 2:1 thresholds; graduates of some Pakistani universities qualify at 65% or CGPA 2.9. Ask admissions which list applies.
Commonwealth PhD Scholarship (CSC run, University page) is open for 2027/28 with a deadline of 20 October 2026 at 16:00 UK time; Pakistan eligibility must be checked on the CSC site.
Developing Solutions Masters Scholarship and Commonwealth Shared Scholarship usually recur; watch for 2027 entry terms.
Both automatic international scholarships exclude students progressing from the Kaplan International College and sponsored students.
